메모: 10번 B2B 제조 홍보영상 이미지 콘티 지시문(2026-10-26 — 02_콘티.md 2절 · 6절). 원본 컷 첫 프레임과 같은 카메라 자리 · 크기 · 높이 · 빛으로 굽는다(만족 사례 장부 S31). 원본 프레임은 넣지 않고 배치도(사람 = 검은 실루엣, 기계 · 공간 = 크게 흐린 윤곽선 — git 밖 콘티/p10/배치)와 기준 그림(R1~R6, 콘티/p10/참조), 준호 참조(명세서 refs 넷)만 넣는다. 33 · 37은 원본 비행기 모양이 남아 배치도를 넣지 않는다. 화면 글자 · 회사 이름은 굽지 않고 후반에서 얹는다. 풀기: python -X utf8 지시문/풀기.py → git 밖 콘티/p10/ego/jobs.json, 받은 그림은 콘티/p10/받음/.

공통.시작: Create one still photograph. A cinematic film still from a Korean heavy-industry company's brand film, wide 16:9 landscape frame, shot on a cinema camera with a fast prime lens and natural shallow depth of field. Keep the main subject inside the middle band of the frame; the top and bottom edges will later be covered by thin black bars.
공통.준호_얼굴: Use the attached photos of the same man (Images 1 to {n}) only as identity references for one Korean man about forty years old. Keep his face exactly the same as in those photos: an oval face with a broad, smooth forehead and a gently rounded jaw; warm light-tan skin with a few faint small freckles on the cheeks; natural eyes with soft double eyelids and fine crow's-feet lines at the outer corners; straight dark eyebrows; a straight nose with a softly rounded tip; clean-shaven with no beard or stubble; short black hair neatly swept to one side with a side part. His expression is calm, steady and serious, with his lips closed and relaxed (no smile). Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos. Do not add glasses, moles, scars, earrings, text, logos or watermarks.
공통.준호_옷: He wears a dark navy work jacket with a small stand-up collar, zipped halfway, over a plain light-grey crew-neck T-shirt, with no logos, no name badges and no text on the clothes.
공통.작업자: Any other worker in the picture shows no face at all: seen from behind, cropped above the shoulders, or with the face hidden by a cap, a white safety helmet seen from above, or a welding mask. Workers wear plain dark-grey work clothes with no logos or text.
공통.터빈: The machine is a large industrial gas turbine for a power plant: a long horizontal machine about four meters tall with a clean warm-ivory (off-white) painted outer casing of bolted curved panels, a large round air intake at the front with a ring of many dark charcoal blades around a smooth dark nose cone with no markings, and a tapered exhaust at the back.
공통.기준R1: Image {n} is the reference photo of the finished gas turbine: keep exactly the same machine shape, ivory casing, bolt lines, round dark blade intake and plain dark nose cone.
공통.기준R2: Image {n} is the reference photo of the bare compressor blade ring: keep the same slim silver blades and the same machined central disc.
공통.기준R3: Image {n} is the reference photo of the assembly hall: keep the same bright white hall, yellow overhead bridge crane, light-grey floor and cool white light.
공통.기준R4: Image {n} is the reference photo of the test cell: keep the same long tunnel with rows of small white square acoustic panels on dark walls.
공통.기준R5: Image {n} is the reference photo of the transport trailer: keep the same low multi-axle trailer, the same plain white truck and the same yellow diamond sticker with only a baby-face pictogram.
공통.기준R6: Image {n} is the reference photo of the power plant at dusk: keep the same plain grey turbine hall, slim exhaust stacks, transmission towers and dusk sky.
공통.배치: Image {n} is a layout guide for the camera framing, made from another film: black silhouettes show exactly where people are and how large they are; grey lines are the soft outline of the large shapes in the frame (machine edges, walls, floor lines) and show their position and size; the light grey area is empty and must be filled with the scene described here. Match the camera position, camera height, lens, framing and the size and position of every shape exactly as in the layout guide, filling the whole 16:9 frame. Do not draw the grey, the black, the lines or any guide shapes.
공통.금지_글자: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no signs with writing and no watermarks anywhere in the picture.
공통.질감: Photorealistic, natural skin texture with visible pores, real metal, paint and concrete textures, slight film grain, no beauty retouching, no illustration look, no CGI sheen.
